SELECT T.* FROM T_EMC_MTL_USE_RECORD T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT S.BATCHNO, S.MTLID, S.EXPIREDATE, S.STANDARDLEVEL, S.STOCKSPECIFICATION, M.MTLNAME, A.USERNAME, B.ORGNAME, L.*, (L.PREVIOUSQTY - L.QTY) AS NUM FROM T_EMC_STOCK_LOG L LEFT JOIN T_EMC_STOCK S ON L.STOCKID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL M ON M.ID = S.MTLID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER A ON L.RECEIVEDBYID = A.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG B ON L.RECEIVEDBYORGID = B.ID WHERE L.LOGTYPE = '领取'
AND S.MTLID like #{mtlid}
